signal: Trunk Tools closed a $40M Series B led by Insight Partners in July 2025 to expand its go-to-market team and scale its construction AI platform.

email.subject1: a signal play for Trunk Tools
email.body1:
Jeff, saw Trunk Tools closed a $40M Series B and is scaling out the go-to-market team.

Scaling that fast usually means more in-market contractors than the sales team can cover before the new hires ramp, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Trunk Tools off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Jeff, quick follow-up for Trunk Tools.

Post-Series-B, board expectations on pipeline usually jump faster than headcount can. Most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to book to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter becomes a scramble to recover.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Trunk Tools needs to close that gap, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Jeff, last bit of proof for Trunk Tools.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Trunk Tools' reply rate likely compares to other Series-B startups. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Jeff, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. The stretch from raise to hiring is its own kind of busy, and I know timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a Series-B motion? I'll tailor it to Trunk Tools either way.
